title: Harold SMP  Season 4 Modpack
description: The official Harold SMP modpack for Season 4 of the server.
body:
**The Harold SMP modpack is the official modpack for S3 and now S4 Harold SMP!** 

(_please note only S4 has an official server._)


> ### **[CHECK OUT HAROLD SMP HERE!](https://modrinth.com/server/harold-smp)**


The modpack comes with many optimization mods as well as simple voice chat zoomify, and more! 

It includes: 

- Many optimization mods like: 

          1. Sodium, 
          2. Lithium, 
          3. Dynamic FPS, 
          4. And more! 

- A few quality of life mods: 

          1. Simple voice chat, 
          2. Appleskin,
          4. And more! (again.)

- And many, many more!
  
The Harold SMP is now once again open fro completly vannila clients! (this means we have bedrock support again).

The modpack will be updated as the seasons of Harold SMP change.
